span.p:
Dispatch command:
• READ_SENSORS → send data packet
• WRITE_MAP → update map + EEPROM
• WRITE_PID → update PID + EEPROM
• WRITE_PRESSURE → update table + EEPROM
• PUMP_PRIME → run pump briefly
